(update 10-15-2026) Ray Hudson at River Valley Marina (501-517-1250) said the water is normal. The crappie have begun to bite again. They’ll bite at 3 feet on jigs — “probably can catch them on minnows, too,” Ray said, “but I’m only hearing about jigs.” Fish in 6 feet of water around the trees. Black bass are still biting. (updated 10-22-2026) Shelley Burr at Cane Creek State Park, (870-628-4714) reports that the lake is very low and overrun with lily pads. She said they only had two anglers out this week. Cane Creek Lake is a 1,700-acre lake in Lincoln County that was built in 1986 and is owned and managed by the AGFC. It is stocked with bass, crappie, bream and catfish.
